attempted_claim: Let P_{l1,l2} be the hyperbolic pair of pants with two variable funnel widths l1,l2>0 and third cuff length fixed (=L0), doubled to a convex-cocompact hyperbolic surface. Let l1->0 be the funnel-to-cusp degeneration, so P_{0,l2} has one hyperbolic cusp. For l1>0 let Pollicott-Ruelle resonances be those of the open-system cutoff resolvent of the geodesic generator X_{l1,l2}; for l1=0 let them be the Bonthonneau-Weich meromorphically continued resolvent (X_{0,l2}-s)^{-1}:C_c^infty->D' on C. Prove, unconditionally and finite-exactly (not asymptotically in |Im s| and not conditionally on the pressure condition delta<=1/2): there exist a compact rectangle K=[0,l*]x[w0,w1] subset [0,infty)x(0,infty), a width beta0=beta0(K,L0)>0, and an integer N=N(K,L0)<infty such that for every (l1,l2) in K the strip {Re s>-beta0} contains at most N Ruelle resonances (counted with multiplicity), uniformly up to and including the cusp limit l1=0. Identify the sharp beta0 threshold in terms of the limit-set data over K and the cusp end.
claim_type: spectral gap threshold for Ruelle resonances
decisive_failure: The investigation attempted three concrete routes (uniform microlocal resolvent, uniform fractal uncertainty, Selberg-zeta reduction) with a reproducible bounded recovery test, but each is blocked by structural degeneration mechanisms; no uniform sharp finite-exact gap could be established and no independently valuable finding emerged.
